name: Jaime Sevilla
bio: Jaime Sevilla is co-founder and director of Epoch AI, a research organization that studies trends in AI. Sevilla's work focuses on forecasting the trajectory of AI, including compute trends, data limits and the FrontierMath benchmark effort. Sevilla also co-founded the Observatorio de Riesgos Catastroficos Globales.
known_for: Co-founder and director of Epoch AI
Forecasting AI compute and data trends
